secondary_offering: Interdepartmental minor open to students in any major.
summary: An interdisciplinary minor requiring three upper-division creative writing courses and two upper-division literature courses selected from approved offerings across campus.
transfer_note: Important for CCC students: Berkeley states that community-college courses cannot satisfy this minor because all minor requirements are upper division.

secondary_offering: The emphasis is completed within the English B.A.
summary: English majors may complete a Creative Writing emphasis with three courses in fiction, nonfiction, and/or poetry; advanced workshops are application-based.
transfer_note: No creative-writing-specific CCC road map was verified; use ASSIST and English advising to map lower-division preparation.

secondary_offering: Open to undergraduates across UCI.
summary: A seven-course minor built around prose fiction and poetry workshops, writing courses, and literature study.
transfer_note: No creative-writing-specific CCC road map was verified; check ASSIST and UCI residence requirements before planning the minor.

secondary_offering: A separate Creative Writing minor is also available.
summary: Qualified English majors may elect a Creative Writing concentration; UCLA also offers a Creative Writing minor with work in poetry, short fiction, nonfiction, screenwriting, playwriting, hybrid genres, and electronic forms.
transfer_note: UCLA provides transfer-specific English advising. Creative Writing workshops are application-only, and transfer students interested in the minor are advised to begin applying early.

secondary_offering: Broader writing major that includes creative and professional writing.
summary: A writing-centered B.A. that blends creative, academic, professional, and disciplinary writing; students can include genre and creative-writing coursework in the major.
transfer_note: UC Merced publishes major-specific transfer selection criteria: transfer applicants must complete at least two approved preparation courses (or equivalents), including options such as Introduction to Creative Writing, with C- or better.

secondary_offering: Creative Writing minor also available.
summary: A standalone Creative Writing B.A. with fields of specialization in fiction, nonfiction, and poetry. UCR describes it as the only Creative Writing major of its kind in the UC system.
transfer_note: No creative-writing-specific CCC road map was verified in this pass; use ASSIST and UCR transfer advising for articulation.

secondary_offering: Literary Arts minor also available.
summary: UC San Diego's Literary Arts B.A. replaced the former Literature/Writing major and combines craft, workshops, literary study, and broad genre options.
transfer_note: Especially useful for transfers: UCSD publishes pre-approved upper-division substitutions for Literary Arts transfer students who still need specified lower-division literature requirements.

program: English B.A. — Las Maestras Center/Creative Writing Specialization
secondary_offering: Departmental specialization connected to the Las Maestras Center.
summary: A department-based English specialization for students developing an original creative voice while connecting craft with questions of social equity, environment, and globalization.
transfer_note: This is a departmental specialization rather than a separate UC degree. Use ASSIST for English B.A. preparation and confirm current specialization requirements after transfer.

secondary_offering: Selective concentration with fiction/prose and poetry tracks.
summary: A selective concentration inside the Literature B.A., with lower- and upper-division workshops and a creative senior project or seminar.
transfer_note: Plan early: applicants must take at least one qualifying lower-division creative writing workshop at UCSC before applying to the concentration. UCSC also publishes transfer guidance for Literature majors.

institution: California Polytechnic State University, San Luis Obispo
program: English B.A. — Optional Creative Writing Emphasis
secondary_offering: Optional emphasis built from upper-division English units and the senior project.
summary: English majors interested in creative writing may shape 16 upper-division English units plus the senior project into a fiction- or poetry-writing emphasis.
transfer_note: This is an optional emphasis within the English B.A., not a separately named degree. No creative-writing-specific CCC road map was verified; use ASSIST and Cal Poly advising.

program: Writing Minor — Creative Writing & Publishing Options
secondary_offering: English B.A. students can also work on the student-run Toyon literary magazine.
summary: A current Writing Minor housed in English. Humboldt’s active creative-writing curriculum includes introductory creative writing, environmental-justice writing, nonfiction, fiction, poetry, and literary editing/publishing.
transfer_note: The current university site confirms the Writing Minor, but a creative-writing-specific CCC road map was not verified. Use ASSIST and Humboldt advising to determine how transfer coursework applies.

program: English B.A. — Emphasis in Creative Writing
secondary_offering: Minor in English: Creative Writing also available.
summary: An optional Creative Writing emphasis within the English B.A.; the department also offers a Creative Writing minor for non-majors.
transfer_note: No creative-writing-specific CCC road map was verified; use ASSIST and CSUCI English advising.

secondary_offering: 12-unit minor housed in the Department of English.
summary: A compact minor with Introduction to Creative Writing plus upper-division choices in poetry, fiction, creative nonfiction, playwriting, and literary-journal editing.
transfer_note: No creative-writing-specific ADT road map was verified; use ASSIST and CSUB program maps for planning.

secondary_offering: English also supports literary editing and publishing work.
summary: A named Creative Writing minor in the English Department. Chico's current English catalog also identifies creative work in fiction, poetry, drama, and creative nonfiction within its undergraduate ecosystem.
transfer_note: No creative-writing-specific ADT road map was verified in this pass; use ASSIST for transferable preparation.

secondary_offering: CSUDH also offers a Professional and Creative Writing certificate.
summary: A Creative Writing minor within English, complemented by a separate professional-and-creative writing certificate and workshop opportunities across creative genres.
transfer_note: No creative-writing-specific CCC transfer map was verified; use ASSIST and department advising.

secondary_offering: Current degree-road-map site includes 2026-27 and ADT pathways.
summary: A Creative Writing concentration within the English B.A. with both four-year and Associate Degree for Transfer road maps.
transfer_note: One of the clearest CCC routes found: CSU East Bay publishes an English ADT → Creative Writing Concentration road map structured around 60 post-transfer semester units.

secondary_offering: Current department page links to 2026-27 degree requirements.
summary: An English B.A. option focused on poetry, fiction, creative nonfiction, and literary publishing, with advanced workshops and advising notes for course sequencing.
transfer_note: Fresno State notes that catalog year may trace to when a student began at an area community college, but no creative-writing-specific ADT road map was verified; use ASSIST and advising.

secondary_offering: 21-unit minor combining creative-writing sequence and literature study.
summary: A 21-unit minor built around Introduction, Intermediate, and Advanced Creative Writing plus literature and upper-division electives.
transfer_note: No creative-writing-specific CCC road map was verified; use ASSIST and CSUF English advising.

secondary_offering: Creative Writing option within the English B.A.
summary: An English B.A. option designed for students who want to write and study fiction, poetry, plays, or media scripts.
transfer_note: No option-specific CCC road map was verified in this pass; confirm articulation in ASSIST and with CSULB advising.

secondary_offering: Minor is open alongside the English B.A.
summary: Cal State LA's current English undergraduate page lists a Creative Writing minor; beginning creative writing introduces fiction, poetry, and drama in a workshop setting.
transfer_note: No creative-writing-specific CCC road map was verified; use ASSIST for course articulation.

program: Humanities & Communication B.A. — Creative Writing & Social Action Concentration
secondary_offering: Creative Writing & Social Action minor also available.
summary: An interdisciplinary concentration connecting creative writing with social action, community engagement, storytelling, and publishing.
transfer_note: A particularly clear CCC option: CSUMB publishes Creative Writing & Social Action transfer pathways for students with an AA-T in English and for students without the AA-T. Verify the pathway year that matches your entry term.

secondary_offering: Published Transfer Road Maps and ADT/STAR Act Road Maps.
summary: A creative-writing option within the English B.A. emphasizing original writing, revision, literary analysis, and an advanced capstone portfolio.
transfer_note: One of the clearest CCC routes found: CSUN publishes a Creative Writing transfer road map plus ADT/STAR road maps, including an AA-T in English route designed for completion within 60 semester units after transfer when eligibility conditions are met.

secondary_offering: English Department also supports the student-produced Calaveras Station Literary Journal.
summary: A Creative Writing minor with introductory creative writing plus fiction or poetry and additional upper-division creative-writing coursework.
transfer_note: No creative-writing-specific CCC road map was verified; use ASSIST and Sacramento State English advising.

secondary_offering: 18-unit concentration in the English B.A.
summary: A concentration spanning aesthetics and craft, poetry, fiction, creative nonfiction, specialized genres, literary production, and a creative-writing thesis/performance experience.
transfer_note: No creative-writing-specific CCC road map was verified; use ASSIST and CSUSB English advising.

secondary_offering: 15-unit minor taught through English & Comparative Literature.
summary: A 15-unit minor with creative-writing study plus workshops in fiction, poetry, screenwriting, creative publishing, and editing.
transfer_note: No creative-writing-specific CCC road map was verified; note the minor's residence requirements and confirm articulation after transfer.

secondary_offering: Creative Writing minor, M.A., and M.F.A. also available.
summary: A dedicated Creative Writing department offering an undergraduate major and minor alongside graduate writing programs, with workshop-centered study and active publishing faculty.
transfer_note: SF State publishes a dedicated ENGL AA-T roadmap for the Creative Writing B.A. The current roadmap is designed for students transferring with an AA-T in English and describes a 60-unit post-transfer completion path, subject to advising and catalog-year requirements.

secondary_offering: Creative Writing minor also available; students can work with Reed Magazine.
summary: A creative-writing concentration with workshops in fiction, poetry, creative nonfiction, and scriptwriting, plus opportunities connected to SJSU's long-running Reed Magazine.
transfer_note: SJSU’s current catalog identifies ADT pathways for the English B.A., Creative Writing Concentration. Confirm the current AA-T/ADT roadmap and course-by-course articulation in ASSIST before enrolling.

secondary_offering: Concentration includes a senior capstone and advanced/experiential coursework.
summary: A workshop-focused concentration in poetry, fiction, and creative nonfiction requiring upper-division work in at least two genres and a senior capstone.
transfer_note: Sonoma English provides general transfer information, but no creative-writing-specific CCC road map was verified in this pass; confirm articulation through ASSIST.
